name: InterleavedBench
description: InterleavedBench is the first benchmark curated for evaluating interleaved text-and-image generation, supporting arbitrarily interleaved images and text for both inputs and outputs across diverse real-world use cases.
reputation: A new benchmark for interleaved image-text generation that is gaining attention in multimodal generation research, but it is still early in community adoption.
notes: Includes InterleavedEval, a GPT-4o powered reference-free metric evaluating text quality, perceptual quality, image coherence, text-image coherence, and helpfulness.
